title: Understanding Body Image and Its Connection to Weight Health Literacy

authorship.current_visible_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team
authorship.recommended_normalized_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team

primary_question: How does body image affect well-being, and how does it connect to weight health literacy?
reader_intent: Understand body image's mental-health effects and paths toward body neutrality.
desired_reader_outcome: Reader understands negative body image's effects and evidence-informed paths (body neutrality/acceptance) toward improvement.
disposition_reason: Distinct, well-hedged psychosocial content with clear escalation-to-professional-support guidance and no specific unsupported numeric claims. Only trivial editing needed.
